# obs-websocket vendor API header

`obs-websocket-api.h` is vendored unmodified so the plugin can emit its alert events as an obs-websocket vendor event.

- Source: https://github.com/obsproject/obs-websocket/blob/68bebc28be57a8ca371404182113e16eeac74cbf/lib/obs-websocket-api.h
- Commit: `68bebc28be57a8ca371404182113e16eeac74cbf` (the `plugins/obs-websocket` submodule pinned by obs-studio tag 32.1.0)
- License: GPL-2.0-or-later (compatible with this plugin's GPLv2); the license header is kept in the file
- API version: `OBS_WEBSOCKET_API_VERSION 3`, 259 lines
- sha256: `c29e8e38ee66c36db79cae86217ab0f270aad39f97e82090809d087c281b7948`

Do not edit the header. To update it, replace the file with a newer upstream version and change this page.
